note: Export shipments are factually confirmed by dated customs records with B/L numbers, destinations (Nepal, Sri Lanka) and HS codes — not merely website claims. Important: the declared HS 842810 (lifts/skip hoists) does NOT match any observed shipment line (82060010 tools, 84254900 jacks, 39172190 plastic hose, 85044010 static converters, 73269099 steel articles); per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — actual HS should be corrected to the observed codes and verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. Company appears to be a manufacturer/trader of garage and workshop equipment (lifting jacks, hose reels, battery stations, service tool boards) exporting largely to Nepal via Sonauli land customs station, with one air-cargo lane to Colombo. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: importkey/volza/eximpedia/trademo free views returned 403 or JS-only shells, and the search backend (searx) was unavailable, so domestic_status is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found'. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free views — left null, not estimated. Note the related Nepal entity 'METAFAB TRADING PVT LTD' appears as a buyer, indicating group-internal trade flows. No PAN/CIN verified in this pass (registries out of scope).
